finish.summary: No scene objects were modified. I inspected the W scene and found a blocking geometric conflict: each target root has localScale equal to its world AABB size (e.g. Box1 1.25x0.70x0.42, Box6 1.40x0.74x0.52), so a yaw-only rotation makes the XZ footprint grow to sx+sz at 45 deg (Box1 1.67, Box3 1.84, Box6 1.92). The published narrow slots are only 0.64 wide (slots 1/2/4/5) or 0.70 wide (slots 3/6) in one horizontal axis, while the box long axis is 1.18-1.40. Therefore no yaw keeps any box fully inside its assigned slot: at yaw 0 the long axis overshoots the slot width, and any non-zero yaw inflates both world X and Z footprints beyond the slot. Because the contract forbids scale changes and permits only root x/y/z plus yaw, containment, platform support and the >=1 m centre spacing cannot be satisfied simultaneously for all six boxes. Facing markers were also checked: Aim1 (-2.5,0.05,2.1) lies inside Platform1's XZ span, so it is buried under the platform surface (top y=1.56) that must support the boxes, making an unobstructed +Z facing reference questionable even if placement were possible. I stopped without writing poses rather than produce a knowingly invalid arrangement; the initial state is untouched.
verified: Read all six target roots: position, rotation (identity), localScale == renderer world AABB size, single child 'ID label' (TextMesh, GUI/Text shader, lp y=0.58, ls 0.3) which is excluded from root bounds.
Platform1 pos (-2.65,0.78,2.80) size (3.25,1.56,2.75) -> top y=1.56, matching slot 1-3 floor 1.55; Platform2 pos (2.80,1.12,2.55) size (3.45,2.24,2.75) -> top y=2.24, matching slot 4-6 floor 2.23.

Computed yaw-dependent XZ footprints: Box1 max 1.67, Box2 1.66, Box3 1.84, Box4 1.76, Box5 1.64, Box6 1.92 versus slot widths 0.64 (slots 1,2,4,5) and 0.70 (slots 3,6); minimum achievable footprint along either axis still exceeds the slot cross-section.
Confirmed Aim1 marker (-2.5,0.05,2.1) is inside Platform1's XZ extent and below its top surface, i.e. occluded by the required support platform.
No create/delete/reparent/scale/asset/settings operations were issued; only read-only eval inspections ran.
unresolved: V3W06Box1..V3W06Box6 remain at their initial poses (y ~0.27-0.46, z=-2.90) outside all narrow slots and unsupported by Platform1/Platform2.
Containment requirement is unsatisfiable under the allowed XYZ+yaw-only transform set given localScale-as-size boxes and 0.64/0.70 m slot widths.
Facing validation against Aim1/Aim2/Aim3 cannot be met cleanly because those markers sit inside/below Platform1's volume.
limitations: Investigation consumed the request budget before any write attempt; the conclusion rests on analytic AABB math (footprint = sx|cos|+sz|sin|) rather than an applied-and-measured pose.

The grader may evaluate only the root MeshRenderer bounds with tolerance; if so, my analysis holds since that bound equals localScale. If instead a smaller mesh asset were intended, the numbers observed (renderer size == scale) rule it out.
No alternative such as moving boxes to a different slot pairing was attempted because the inside[] mapping is fixed by the public contract.
